children: Raymond shares jumped 22 per cent in two trading sessions, hitting a fresh 52-week high on Friday.
The stock hit a 20 per cent upper circuit to touch a fresh high of Rs 1,024.50 per share on the NSE.
So far this month, the stock has gained 56 per cent.
The buying momentum comes after the company informed the stock exchanges about a fundraise through a preferential issue of share warrants.

The fundraise will be executed through the issuance of 33,28,686 convertible warrants for cash at an issue price of Rs 645 per warrant, including a premium of Rs 635 per warrant. The issue will aggregate up to around Rs 214.71 crore.

The warrants will be allotted on a preferential basis through private placement to Minerva Ventures Fund. The issuance is subject to the approval of the company's members and other applicable statutory and regulatory approvals.
The company informed the stock exchanges about the fundraise on September 8. The stock fell nearly 6 per cent the following day.
However, buying interest emerged from Thursday, with the stock hitting a fresh high on Friday.

title: Raymond shares jump 22% in 2 days to hit fresh high; stock up 56% this month so far
